  - Redwood response (annotated redline + comments) -> within 3 business days after receipt of Acme redline
  - For changes requiring product/engineering input (SLA/availability/KPIs), allow up to 5 business days for internal review before counter-offer
- Dependencies:
  - Technical SLA items will need input from Neha (Product) and Rishi (Sales/Platform) - I'll loop them in on specific clauses.
  - Any third-party subprocessors or procurement questions should be escalated to procurement contacts listed in the MAP spreadsheet.

Action items from Redwood side:
1) I will confirm Redwood legal owner - tagging Michael Grant to own edits and the consolidated redline file.
2) Rishi/Neha: please stand by for clause-level questions; we'll aim to keep technical clarifications scoped to the SLA appendix.
3) Asha: please send your initial redline (or confirm you want the attached draft MSA as the starting point).

Hi Marissa / Asha - copying in product and sales as requested. I will own the Redwood-side edits and maintain the consolidated redline. Confirmations and proposed SLAs from Redwood legal:

1) Ownership: Redwood legal (Michael Grant) will be the primary owner for Redwood's edits, comment resolution, and the consolidated redline file (Redwood_MSA_comments.docx). I will track changes and keep both counsel in sync.

2) Turnaround times:
   - Redwood will provide an annotated response to Acme's initial redline within 3 business days of receipt.
   - For clauses that require product/engineering sign-off (SLA, availability, data residency specifics, metrics), please allow up to 5 business days to coordinate internal review and produce a technical response. Neha, please advise on any SLA items that will need extended review.

3) Process / responsibilities:
   - Acme provides initial redline (done).
   - Redwood legal produces annotated redline and any proposed alternates; where Redwood proposes technical countermeasures (e.g., compensating controls instead of a strict uptime %), we will call out the dependency and estimated review time.
   - Counters will be exchanged until both sides reach agreement. We propose a maximum of 3 full cycles before escalation to execs (Marissa/Asha + Rishi).

4) Delivery and signatures: once legal terms and SLA appendix are agreed, Marissa can coordinate procurement/PO and DocuSign flow. Please post any DocuSign links to the thread and HubSpot deal record.

I'll start a consolidated redline and circulate within 48 hours after I finish the initial pass.
